title: Text animations
summary: Title cards and text overlays in the modern editorial look: one huge white word in heavy Montserrat capitals that builds and drops out letter by letter in a scattered order through a translucent ghost, over charcoal and picture panels (strips, slots, mosaics, punch-in cards) in studio-light tones or your own stills.
usage: Title cards fill the frame (square to 9:16): {"background": {"piece": "text/headline-slam", "props": {"lines": ["YOUR", "WORDS"]}}} or a footage "cutaway". Fields: charcoal (default), black, graphite, bone. Picture panels take tones (ember, teal, bone, rose, steel, ink, olive, cobalt, sand) or "image"/"images" (server paths to stills). Overlays are see-through, in 1080x1920 frame pixels: {"piece": "text/keyword-slam", "start": 1.2, "end": 3.4, "props": {"word": "LISTEN", "y": 1560}}; they leave letter by letter before `life` ends. Props match the other themes so storyboards can switch. Kit: library/themes/modern/kit.js.

items.name: Headline
items.description: Three picture strips slide in from alternate ends with staggered edges; the headline builds letter by letter in a scattered order (ghost, then solid) across them, then drops out and the strips leave. images: stills for the strips.

items.name: Split stack
items.description: Top word builds on charcoal; a picture slot opens below and widens to the edges and the bottom word builds over it. Caption under the top word, note at the foot.

items.name: Marquee wall
items.description: A wall of heavy capitals in rows running opposite ways; one row snaps solid per beat while the rest stay ghosted.

items.name: Statement
items.description: A sentence in heavy left-aligned capitals, one word per beat, each building letter by letter; emphasis words sit on a picture block that wipes in behind them. Tag, rule and foot.

items.name: Big number
items.description: A picture card punches up from the middle to full frame on the beat while a huge figure counts up over it; kicker above, label and note below.

items.name: Quote card
items.description: A narrow picture slot opens and widens at the top with a quote mark on it; the quote arrives a word per beat in heavy sentence case; rule and attribution.

items.name: Agenda
items.description: Title builds at the top; each item lands on its beat with a picture-strip thumbnail wiping in, a mono number and heavy capitals.

items.name: Versus
items.description: Upper and lower picture panels slide in from opposite sides; word A builds on top, word B below, VS in a charcoal tab on the seam.

items.name: Chapter
items.description: A huge ghosted chapter number, a picture slot opening across the middle and the title building over it; kicker and note.

items.name: Countdown
items.description: Each count punches a new picture card to full frame behind a huge digit that builds and drops out; GO on the last beat.

items.name: End card
items.description: A 2x2 picture mosaic wipes in cell by cell; the closing lines build over it; action, handle and a strip of small type.

items.name: Keyword slam
items.description: One huge white word, centred, building in a scattered order and dropping out letter by letter before it ends; small kicker. color: ink for bright footage; order: scatter/left/right/centre/edges.

items.name: Highlight swipe
items.description: A line of heavy type built word by word; the marked words get a solid charcoal block wiping in behind them.

items.name: Lower third
items.description: A charcoal strap slides in from the left; the name builds in heavy capitals, a hairline draws, the role types on.

items.name: Side text
items.description: Heavy capitals running up the frame edge, building letter by letter, with a small tracked sub line.

items.name: Marquee band
items.description: A charcoal band wipes across with heavy capitals running through it, solid and ghosted words alternating, and a white tab label.

items.name: Corner labels
items.description: Small tracked labels type on in the four corners in turn, each with a short hairline; optional heavy mark.

items.name: Picture-in-picture frame
items.description: A slot opens to a hairline frame (or charcoal card), corner ticks lock on, a white tab label and a running frame number.

items.name: Sticker
items.description: A white square tag punches in on the beat with the word in heavy charcoal capitals and a tracked line along its foot.
